description: Port of Ruff's F523 (string-dot-format-extra-positional-arguments): a `.format` call on a valid format string with a positional argument (not starred; counted by syntactic index, past a starred one too) that no automatic or numbered field reads. `formatArgs` reads the format string receiving `.format` (a str literal with no f/t/b prefix, implicit concatenations joined, escapes decoded, parentheses transparent) with the `braceFormat` grammar (a port of ruff_python_literal's format parser as pyflakes' FormatSummary reads it), and the call's arguments as Ruff's strings.rs does. Ported from the Ruff conformance suite (rerail/conformance/ruff/rules/F523.json at 3f102adcb), with Ruff's `# noqa` honoured as the Ruff CLI honours it.
